question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_id, rental_id, payment_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date ASC) as rn
    FROM payment
),
first_rental_per_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id, rental_id, payment_date
    FROM first_payment_per_customer
    WHERE rn = 1
),
first_movie_rating AS (
    SELECT fp.customer_id, fi.rating
    FROM first_rental_per_customer fp
    JOIN rental r ON fp.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film fi ON i.film_id = fi.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(amount) as total_amount,
           COUNT(rental_id) as total_rentals,
           COUNT(DISTINCT rental_id) as distinct_rentals
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_with_first_rating AS (
    SELECT fm.customer_id, fm.rating, ct.total_amount, ct.total_rentals, ct.distinct_rentals
    FROM first_movie_rating fm
    JOIN customer_totals ct ON fm.customer_id = ct.customer_id
)
SELECT rating,
       AVG(total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
       AVG(total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_with_first_rating
GROUP BY rating
ORDER BY rating
